desc: Derive the exact DP transition for a fixed deleted value, including initialization, restarting a subarray, and the special behavior when the current element equals the deleted value.
Implement a segment tree supporting range add and range chmax, applying both operations to all candidate deletion values except the current value in \(O(\log n)\) amortized time.
Handle unseen deleted values, negative-only arrays, the “at most once” option, and the constraint that the resulting array must remain non-empty.
Prove that the maintained global maximum equals the best subarray sum over all allowable deletion choices.
Verify the complete implementation on both examples and edge cases.
